# This exists because the two lists live in different repositories and
# nothing keeps them in step. That drift is what produced PR #291:
# twelve datatypes were unmapped here, five of them auxiliary and
# correctly so, the rest not.
#
# To refresh:
#
#   curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ComPlat/chemotion-converter-app/\
#     refs/heads/master/converter_app/options.py | sed -n '/^DATA_TYPES = (/,/^)/p'
#
# then deal with whatever the test reports. Refreshing it without reading
# the failures defeats the point.
#
# .github/workflows/upstream_datatypes.yml runs that fetch weekly and fails
# when this snapshot has drifted, so it should not go stale silently.
#
